title: Newsdeck Publisher Node Input
description: Input to the Newsdeck Publisher node in Workflows. The node sets columnId itself and reads fields from item.* (e.g. item.title, item.description) when its own fields are left empty. This is the workflows-event-schema without columnId.

title.description: Headline. The only required field. Must be non-empty.

id.description: Source's own ID (optional, not unique). Used for deduplication within a column: a new item with the same id replaces the previous one in the column view.

source.description: Source name, e.g. Sponichi, Trafikverket, Polisen. Use a readable name, not a URL - put the link in url instead. Default: workflows.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-06-11T05:00:00Z. Invalid or missing values fall back to server time.

category.description: Event category, e.g. sport, trafikolycka, brand.

severity.description: Severity level - free text string. Can be null.

location.description: Geographic information. Stored as-is in JSONB (coordinates are normalized).

name.description: Free-text place name, e.g. E4 vid Rotebro.

county.description: County name in free text, e.g. Stockholms lan.

municipality.description: Municipality name in free text, e.g. Stockholm.

extra.description: Optional extra fields for this item, e.g. language, translated.
